text: dsh-focus-mode 是 DSH 的专注模式预设，通过 bundle 装配持久终端会话和混合工具执行。它为 agent 提供可复用的 shell 命令、输入输出读取、会话列表与关闭能力，并组合直接工具调用和程序化执行，适合需要持续命令行工作的开发者。运行依赖宿主提供终端、作业、工作目录及 PTC 能力。

dsh-focus-mode is a DSH preset for persistent shell sessions and hybrid execution. Agents can reuse sessions, send input, read output, list shells, and close them. It suits ongoing command-line work. The host provides terminal, jobs, working-directory, and PTC capabilities.
想让 DSH 的命令行会话能在多次调用之间保持并复用。
需要在 DSH 里启动后台命令，再查看输出或继续给它输入。
How can I make command sessions persist across multiple calls in DSH?
dsh-focus-mode 的功能「持久命令会话」：为 agent 创建并管理可复用的 shell 会话；通过命令工具运行命令、读取输出、发送输入、列出会话或关闭会话。

dsh-focus-mode README · dsh-focus-mode：English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

An external [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) preset with persistent shell sessions, direct tool calls, and TypeScript program execution. No dsh source or frontend patches are required.

dsh-focus-mode README · dsh-focus-mode：Compatibility: dsh `>=0.2.1-rc.3`, validated against upstream commit `22ddee3792402c3e70ec5f86a63c3e3e895a2f60`. Node.js `>=24.9` is required. This repository extracts the 0.1.2 plugin implementation; its runtime sources and bundle declaration match that implementation.

dsh-focus-mode README · Install a prebuilt package：Downloadable packages are published on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Stautaffly/dsh-focus-mode/releases). Use the official dsh CLI to install the archive directly; users do not need to clone the repository, prepare a host checkout, or install TypeScript. This plugin has not been published to npm.

Use the CLI belonging to your target DSH application and an initialized Web profile. For a profile named `web`:

dsh-focus-mode README · Install a prebuilt package：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Stautaffly/dsh-focus-mode/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-focus-mode-0.2.0.tgz
```

Replace `web` with your actual profile name, such as `web-vanilla`; this command changes only the selected profile. Restart that DSH application after installation, refresh the browser, and choose **Focus mode** in a new session. Installation adds a preset without changing your current default.

To check that the bundle was discovered, run:

dsh-focus-mode README · Install a prebuilt package：```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

The output should contain `external-preset-focus-mode`. The compatibility requirements at the top of this README still apply; this release does not upgrade the host.

dsh-focus-mode README · Update：Choose a compatible version from [Releases](https://github.com/Stautaffly/dsh-focus-mode/releases), then run the same `dsh plugin --profile ... add <release-archive-url>` command with that version's download URL and restart the application. The example above pins `0.1.2`; repeating it reinstalls that version rather than selecting a future release automatically.

dsh-focus-mode README · Remove：Finish sessions using the preset, then remove the bundle from the same profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-focus-mode
```

Restart the application and refresh the browser after removal. Existing sessions retain their recorded preset selection; choose another preset before continuing them without this plugin.

For local builds and installation from a directory or archive, see [development](#development).

dsh-focus-mode README · Behavior：- `exec_command({cmd, session_id?, cwd?, run_in_background?, new_session?})` runs a command in an Agent-owned persistent shell. Working directory and environment survive successive calls: omitting `session_id` reuses this Agent's most recently used live shell, so the caller does not have to carry an id forward. Pass `new_session:true` to start another shell; `cwd` starts one for that directory and applies only at creation. A background command that omits `session_id` starts its own shell, because a background job owns the whole shell.
- `write_stdin({session_id, chars?, run_in_background?, close?})` reads new output or sends input. A newline submits input; a standalone Ctrl-C interrupts. `close:true` closes the shell and releases its slot.
- `focus_sessions({})` lists the shells this Agent owns with their `session_id`, running or exited state, whether a call or background job is using each one, and which shell an omitted `session_id` reuses.
- Every result is a structured value: `session_id`, `status`, `created`, `send`, `wait`, `text`, and `incomplete`, plus `exit_code`, `signal`, or `job_id` when they apply. Direct calls render the same `[session

dsh-focus-mode README · Behavior：The preset retains agent instructions, time context, compaction, skills, web tools, deliverables, plugin inspection/management, and workflows. Additional visible tools from Agent Teams, session search, worktrees, or terminal plugins are inherited automatically. Direct schemas plus the program SDK increase prompt size; PTC can keep intermediate results out of the conversation history.

dsh-focus-mode README · Configuration：The plugin defaults to four persistent shell sessions per Agent and two background jobs per Agent. Session count is configurable from 1 to 64. `reuseMostRecentSession` keeps calls that omit `session_id` on one shell; turn it off to require an explicit `session_id` or `new_session` on every call. The upstream jobs registry has a separate concurrent-job limit. The [16-session/16-job example](examples/limits-16.patch.yml) overrides both:

dsh-focus-mode README · Configuration：```sh
dsh --profile focus-sandbox --patch ./examples/limits-16.patch.yml --dump-config
dsh --profile focus-sandbox --patch ./examples/limits-16.patch.yml
```

`--patch` applies to that launch. For a permanent override, merge the example's two rows into the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, preserving other settings and existing fields on the `jobs` row.

dsh-focus-mode README · Configuration：In this dsh version, a profile patch replaces a matched row's **whole config**. The command tools are nested in a preset declaration, so the example restates `external-preset-focus-mode` and changes `persistent-shell → focus-commands → config.maxSessionsPerAgent`. A top-level `preset: focus-mode` / `id: focus-commands` patch is not supported. Keep a copied preset declaration aligned with future bundle upgrades.

dsh-focus-mode README · Configuration：| Command-tool option | Default | Allowed range |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backendType` | `shell` | Registered terminal backend |
| `maxSessionsPerAgent` | 4 | 1–64 |
| `maxBackgroundJobsPerAgent` | 2 | 1–64 |
| `reuseMostRecentSession` | `true` | boolean |
| `bindChangeRequests` | `true` | boolean |
| `maxResultBytes` | 262144 | 256–16777216 bytes |
| `yieldMs` | 1000 | 0–60000 ms |
| `pollMs` | 50 | 1–10000 ms |
| `readLines` | 10000 | 1–100000 |

dsh-focus-mode README · Configuration：Result byte limits include metadata. Truncation retains the tail and reports possible loss; increase the read/retention settings and rerun a command when omitted output is required. Terminal send timeouts and scrollback retention belong to the `terminal-bash` / `terminal-pwsh` configuration.

dsh-focus-mode README · Development：Only plugin developers need a host source checkout. The `0.2.1-rc.3` native/PTC executor packages used by this baseline are not published on npm. Development builds and integration tests therefore use a prepared checkout; they do not substitute the incompatible published alpha versions. `.npmrc` disables automatic peer installation, and the lockfile pins development tools and ordinary dependencies.

Prepare a separate host checkout at the compatibility commit:

dsh-focus-mode README · Development：```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git ../deepseek-harness
git -C ../deepseek-harness checkout 22ddee3792402c3e70ec5f86a63c3e3e895a2f60

dsh-focus-mode README · Follow the host's installation/build instructions, including native addon prerequisites.：```

Then, from this plugin repository:

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
DSH_SOURCE="$PWD/../deepseek-harness" npm run link:host
npm run typecheck
npm run build
DSH_SOURCE="$PWD/../deepseek-harness" npm test
mkdir -p dist
npm run pack:release
```

Install the resulting archive into a development profile with the official CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile focus-sandbox add ./dist/dsh-focus-mode-0.1.2.tgz
```

text: dsh-focus-mode README · Follow the host's installation/build instructions, including native addon prerequisites.：`DSH_SOURCE` is explicit; there are no personal paths or vendored host sources. The test configuration reads the host's source aliases and decorator transform, and generates a lazy fixture import map. The 24 existing tests cover real Loader/PTY/jobs behavior, dynamic tool registration and withdrawal, authorization, cancellation/cleanup, pagination, direct/PTC ordering and logs, Web/addon composition, and isolated directory/archive installation and removal. They use no model keys or real model requests.

dsh-focus-mode README · Limitations：- Compatibility is pinned to one pre-stable host baseline; upgrades require revalidation.
- Shell sessions live in memory and do not survive a process restart. Exited sessions count toward the quota until closed. Agent or plugin teardown closes owned terminals.
- The scrollback interface lacks a monotonic byte cursor. Identical output replacing an entire retained window cannot always be distinguished; already discarded bytes cannot be recovered.
- The profile must provide the upstream Web host capabilities and a PTC runtime. This bundle does not launch a server or configure a model/network provider.
- Full browser UI, real providers, and Windows/macOS behavior were not covered by the Linux keyless suite. The preset name and description do not use the host's built-in preset translation table.
dsh-focus-mode README · License：[MIT](LICENSE). DeepSeek Harness is a separate upstream project; this is an independently maintained plugin.
